answer: Every claim gets one number: the cost to reproduce it. Reviewers stake 50 POA and spot-check 10 percent of submissions; a panel sharing a subnet is void and its votes return zero. Each submission carries a fresh nonce on a 90 second quartz window, so a copied signature expires before reuse. An attacker reproduces 1,000 identities at 50,000 POA in stakes held like timber in a yard, and a sonnet about staking still scores 0 because the panel grades mechanism.
